question: Which, if either, of two %R slope reads at entry marks never-green desk entries?

hypotheses.H1_flat: flat = max(|wr_d5_fast|, |wr_d5_slow|) <= 10.7 marks never-green (fixed 11/04 before data; origin: sideways test 11/04, z +1.5, exploratory)
hypotheses.H2_steep: steep = wr_d5_fast >= 30.0 (fast %R line rose 30 or more points over the last 5 closed minutes) marks never-green (origin: 11/05, 5 never-greens vs 6 others, 4/5 vs 1/6 above 30; exploratory, n=11, post hoc; the closed 10/30 pitch study on 230,128 events found steep slow-pitch bands no worse than others, which argues against)

data: desk entries from 2026-11-06, features.wr_d5_fast / wr_d5_slow from ai_reports/outcomes.jsonl (ai_watch_wr_slope_log, live since 11/04 16:00); never-green = peak_price < entry +5 bp (hold-length dependent, stated limitation); net = (exit-entry)/entry bp - 3 bp
read_when: 150 forward entries with the slope fields; tools/studies/wr_slope_forward.py prints NOT DUE before that
multiple_comparisons: two hypotheses -> each needs pooled one-sided z >= 1.96 (p < 0.025)

pass_each.never_green: flagged-group never-green rate above the rest in BOTH halves (split by date at the median) and pooled z >= 1.96
pass_each.payoff: mean net of the unflagged group above the mean of all in both halves and the day-clustered bootstrap 5th percentile of (unflagged - all) > 0
pass_each.power: each half needs >= 40 flagged entries and >= 8 days, else UNDERPOWERED for that hypothesis
pass_each.confound: if rs_rng15_bp is present (range-position logger), the never-green gap must be positive in >= 2 of 3 range terciles

if_pass: skeptic review of the positive, then an observe-only flag in the Gates column, then a gate only through the sweep and ship-log rules; never straight to live
if_fail: close; no retuning of 10.7, 30.0, the 5-minute window or the label; record in the running list and memory
